zh-CN.label: 产品流程示意 · 非任务实录

scenes.title:
一个人做产品，
谁来接住整段工作？
scenes.voice: 一个人做产品，难的往往是接住整段工作。用户反馈、需求判断、实现、验收，还有最后的交付说明。

scenes.title:
把一批用户反馈，
变成可演示的新版本。
scenes.accent: 示例目标：改进项目中的批量导入体验
cards: 可运行页面与检查结果
scenes.voice: 以改进批量导入为例。目标不只是一段代码，而是预览、校验和错误提示形成完整体验，并留下可检查的结果。

scenes.title:
围绕同一个目标，
继续推进。
scenes.accent: Mission 组织目标、阶段和任务进展
cards: 为什么改、改到什么程度
scenes.voice: OpenCorvus 用 Mission 组织目标和任务进展。工作跨过多个阶段时，可以沿着已有记录继续，而不是每次重新交代背景。

scenes.title:
上一阶段的产物，
成为下一步的依据。
scenes.accent: 协作的价值，在于交接得上
scenes.voice: 专家团按阶段协作：分析明确边界，实现交付代码，复核对照要求检查。关键不是用了多少个智能体，而是产物能不能接得上。

scenes.title:
“异常行也要能导出。”
接下来，补完整。
scenes.accent: 一次实质修改，贯穿受影响的交付物
scenes.voice: 当你提出异常行也要能导出，后续工作就要覆盖实现、检查和说明。你审关键结果，再给出下一步要求。

scenes.title:
收到的不是一句完成，
而是可验收的结果。
scenes.accent: 打开产物，对照要求，决定是否接受
scenes.voice: 交付时，打开实际产物，检查文件与差异，核对检查结果和未完成项。是否满足要求，由你判断。

scenes.tag: 开源 · 可配置模型 · 可检查产物
scenes.title:
让 AI 的工作，
围绕交付组织起来。
scenes.accent: OpenCorvus / 面向多阶段工作的 Agent 工作台
scenes.voice: OpenCorvus 是面向多阶段工作的开源智能体工作台。需要配置可用模型并保持运行。实际效果取决于任务、模型和你的验收。

scenes.title:
带上你的项目，
试一段完整工作。
scenes.voice: 带上你的项目，选一个有边界的目标，写清验收标准。从一段完整工作开始，看看 OpenCorvus 能为你接住多少交付。

en-US.label: ILLUSTRATED WORKFLOW · NOT A RECORDED RUN

scenes.title:
Building solo?
The work keeps going.
scenes.accent: Set the goal. Review the key results.
scenes.voice: Building a product solo means carrying the whole job. Feedback, requirements, implementation, verification, and the explanation that makes a change usable.

scenes.title:
Turn feedback into
something you can demo.
scenes.accent: Example goal: improve a project's bulk import experience
scenes.voice: Consider a better bulk import experience. The outcome includes preview, validation, and useful error handling, with a working result you can inspect.

scenes.title:
One goal.
Keep the work moving.
scenes.accent: Mission organizes the goal, stages, and task progress
cards: Why it matters and what fits
scenes.voice: OpenCorvus uses Mission to organize goals and task progress. Across stages, existing records give the next step context, reducing the need to explain the job again.

scenes.title:
Artifacts connect
one stage to the next.
scenes.accent: The value of a squad is in the handoff
cards: Code and a way to run it
scenes.voice: Specialist squads work across stages. Analysis defines boundaries, implementation produces code, and review checks requirements. The useful question is whether their artifacts connect.

scenes.title:
Export invalid rows.
Carry the change through.
scenes.accent: A meaningful revision reaches every affected deliverable
scenes.voice: You ask to export invalid rows. The follow-up now needs implementation, checks, and updated instructions. You review key results and set the next direction.

scenes.title:
Open the result.
Decide if it is done.
scenes.accent: Acceptance starts with something you can inspect
scenes.voice: At delivery, open the result. Inspect files and changes. Read check results and unfinished items. You decide whether the work meets the requirements.

scenes.title:
Organize AI work
around delivery.
scenes.accent: OpenCorvus / An agent workbench for multi-stage work
scenes.voice: OpenCorvus is an open source agent workbench for multi-stage work. Configure an available model and keep the runtime running. Results depend on the task, model, and your review.

scenes.title:
Bring your project.
Try the whole workflow.
scenes.voice: Bring your project. Choose a bounded goal and write down what done means. Try a complete workflow, and see how much of the delivery OpenCorvus can help carry.
